hero_title: Find the trail no one is talking about.
hero_subtitle: Weekend treks, sunrise hikes, nature walks and offbeat outdoor experiences across Jaipur and Rajasthan—built for solo explorers, friend groups and teams.
about: Weekend Crew is a Jaipur-based trekking, travel and adventure community created for people who want to make their weekends more exciting. We discover hidden and lesser-known locations instead of repeating the same popular trails. Every experience blends exploration with games, music, interactive activities, photography, snacks and refreshments.
seo_title: Weekend Treks & Adventure Tours in Jaipur Rajasthan
seo_description: Join Weekend Crew for sunrise hikes, hidden trails, nature walks, fort treks and group adventures from Jaipur across Rajasthan. Solo travellers are welcome.
